name: 位置と連絡先をまとめる会話添付
prompt:
Generate one faithful Lighthouse conversation-attachments screen matching native LH03-0157. Keep the full canvas exactly 390:748 and show only the authored attachment stack on a clean white background.

Use the native preview as authority for exact Japanese copy, positions, card shapes, colors and spacing. Use the original Telegram screenshot only as authority for the two map images, labels, timestamps and attachment types. Keep the items in this exact order:
1. Right-aligned pale-mint file card: 「共有画像.png」, 「15.5 KB」, and a small green outlined image icon.
2. One map card at the native size and position, with the blue location pin at the 9TH ST / N ST intersection, Apple Maps label and dark-green timestamp pill 「21:49」.
3. A second map card showing the different pale street map with the small circular person photo/portrait at its pin and the muted timestamp 「9:50 PM」 with checkmark.
4. Right-aligned pale-mint audio card with the green outlined play triangle, 「会話の録音.m4a」 and 「29.6 KB」.
5. Right-aligned pale-mint contact card with the dark-green initial 「山」, the dark-green contact name 「山田 はるか」, then exactly these three contact links:
「03 1234 5678」
「090 1234 5678」
「連絡先@example.jp」
Render all three phone/email strings in clear medium blue because they are hyperlinks, matching the provided blue hyperlink color reference. Keep the contact name green. At the bottom, preserve the small dark-green button text 「メッセージを送る」; it is a button label, not hyperlink text.

Preserve both maps as closely as possible to the original map artwork and their native crops; do not invent new streets, buildings, pins or labels. Keep the first map's bright blue pin as artwork, not link text. Use a Japanese initial in place of the original contact photo, as shown in the native preview.

Do not add chat wallpaper, bubbles, message text, unrelated controls, extra files, or additional contacts. Keep the exact canvas, right/left alignment, pale mint file/audio/contact cards, and quiet white spacing from the native preview.
reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。共有画像・二つの地図・音声・連絡先を順に保持し、電話2件とメールを青い下線リンクとして表示。名前/送信ボタンは緑を維持。native 390x748比で最初のファイルカードは約10px低く、map1は約5px低く少し短い、map2は約4px高く約10px短い。音声カードは約13px上、連絡先カードは約10px上かつ約10px左で、幅も約8px広い。地図細部は元画像の完全な画素一致でない。needs-correctionで保持。所有者承認・編集可能性・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
